briefing:
# Canva: Pre-Meeting Briefing for 17 November 2026

## Executive Summary

Canva announced on 3 November 2026 a restructuring affecting 1,271 employees, about 22% of its workforce. The reorganisation merges Product, Growth and Platform into one product organisation, simplifies management layers and concentrates more product teams in Sydney ([Greenwood, n.d.](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250); [Niehues, 2026, November 9](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). Canva describes the change as a response to its first growth slowdown in a decade, although the company remains profitable ([Bashir, 2026, November 4](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/canva-first-growth-slowdown-decade-092457264.html); [Greenwood, n.d.](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250)).

Over the same 30-day window, Canva's product news centred on enterprise positioning, but the source material for those launches is weakly dated (see the verification section). No leadership hires or deal announcements dated within the window could be confirmed from the provided material.

**Briefing window:** 16 October to 15 November 2026. Sources are classified as primary (company), tier-one or tier-two press, or commentary.

## 1. What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### 1.1 Restructuring and Workforce Changes

The core development is the restructuring announced in CEO Melanie Perkins' internal note, "An important update on our team," published on Canva's newsroom ([Canva, 2026, November 3](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-team-update)). The note confirms several operational details:

- Employees leaving Canva keep access to Slack and Gmail until the end of the week so they can tell their teams.
- Org Leads were to share area-level changes by the end of that week.
- A Company All Hands took place on 10 November, followed by Org All Hands from 11 November ([Canva, 2026, November 3](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-team-update)).

The scale of the change is reported consistently across outlets. Newsweek reports that 1,271 employees, 22% of the workforce, are affected. The figure includes staff being asked to relocate, so the number who will actually leave is not yet known ([Greenwood, n.d.](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250)). Canva has not disclosed how many affected people will leave the company ([Niehues, 2026, November 9](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). Perkins' note is reported to have said the affected roles include job cuts, new roles and relocations to central hubs ([Bashir, 2026, November 4](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/canva-first-growth-slowdown-decade-092457264.html)).

Key structural changes are summarised below.

| Dimension | Reported detail | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Affected staff | 1,271 (about 22% of workforce), including relocations | [Greenwood, n.d.](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250) |
| Org design | Product, Growth and Platform merging into one product organisation | [Niehues, 2026, November 9](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Management | Layers simplified; narrow roles combined | [LinkedIn, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140) |
| Geography | Sydney to become primary home for more product teams and other roles | [Greenwood, n.d.](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250) |
| Severance | At least six months' salary (about 26 weeks) for departing staff | [Niehues, 2026, November 9](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Office policy | 2–3 expected office days per week (infographic in trade coverage) | [Gomes, 2026, November 12](https://ctomagazine.com/canva-layoff-2026-workforce-restructuring-what-leaders-need-to-understand) |
| Breakdown | No published breakdown by title, department or country | [Greenwood, n.d.](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250) |

**Assessment.** The restructuring is best read as an organisational-design decision. Canva's own framing, relayed by Newsweek and Niehues, is that the goal is to reduce handover delays and management layers, not to respond to a cash problem. Niehues states that a Canva spokesperson said AI is not replacing the affected roles ([Niehues, 2026, November 9](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). Because relocations are counted in the 1,271 figure, the headline number overstates the expected net job losses. The severance terms (at least six months) are also notably generous compared with the 11.2-week technology-sector average for 2024 cited by Niehues ([Niehues, 2026, November 9](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)).

### 1.2 Further Cuts or a Hiring Freeze

A report from Capital Brief, relayed by People Matters, says Canva could announce another round of redundancies or a company-wide hiring freeze in November ([Srivastava, 2026, November 3](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)). This is a secondhand report of a possibility, not a confirmed plan. Canva has not confirmed it in the materials reviewed. It should be treated as unverified.

### 1.3 Product and Enterprise Launches

MarTech Cube reports Canva's enterprise-oriented launches from the Canva Create event. The article's publication date is not shown in the material provided. The reported announcements include:

- **Canva Enterprise**, a new subscription for large organisations ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products)).
- **The biggest redesign in more than a decade**, described as a new experience designed for work ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products)).
- **Canva Courses and Work Kits**, new workplace learning products ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products)).
- **Data Autofill**, which pulls data from third-party sources such as Salesforce and the MLS, and **Bulk Create**, which generates designs from CSV or Excel files ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products)).
- **Affinity v2.5**, with variable font support and a stroke width tool, extending the Affinity acquisition to professional designers ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products)).

Company metrics cited in the same article include more than 185 million monthly active users, more than US$2.3 billion in annualised revenue, and use by teams at 95% of Fortune 500 companies ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products)). Canva's Visual Economy Report is cited as finding that 92% of business leaders expect non-design employees to have design skills ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products)).

**Timing caveat.** Because the article date is not visible, I cannot confirm that these launches fall within the 30-day window. The product set is consistent with the enterprise strategy that Futurum analysed in May 2026, which is outside the window and is used here only as background ([Kirkpatrick, 2026, May 28](https://futurumgroup.com/insights/canvas-may-2026-launches-signal-an-enterprise-platform-ambition-beyond-design)).

### 1.4 Acquisitions

Demand Gen Report covers Canva's acquisition of Ortto and Simtheory, quoting Ortto and Simtheory's CEO Mike Sharkey on bringing their technology to Canva's user base ([Demand Gen Report, n.d.](https://www.demandgenreport.com/industry-news/news-brief/canva-acquisitions-expands-marketing-ai-capabilities/52546)). The article is undated in the material provided, and I cannot confirm when the deal closed or was announced. It should not be presented as a within-window deal without verification. The same article's claim that "a quarter of a billion people" use Canva monthly conflicts with the 185 million monthly active users cited by MarTech Cube ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products)).

### 1.5 Leadership Hires

No leadership hires dated within the window were found in the materials reviewed. The Canva memo itself references "Leads" and "Org Leads" overseeing the reorganised areas, but does not name new appointments ([Canva, 2026, November 3](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-team-update)). This gap should be checked against Canva's newsroom before the meeting.

## 2. Financial and Strategic Context

Canva's financial position is central to interpreting the restructuring. The main figures reported are:

| Metric | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| 2026 revenue growth expectation | About 20% year-on-year | [Greenwood, n.d.](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250) |
| Prior growth forecast (August 2026) | Cut from 30% to 20%, per Fortune | [Niehues, 2026, November 9](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Profitability | 2026 is the tenth consecutive profitable year, per the company | [Greenwood, n.d.](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250) |
| Prior-year revenue | US$3.5 billion, per The Register | [Niehues, 2026, November 9](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Annualised revenue | More than US$2.3 billion (product-cited figure) | [MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products) |

The figures contain an apparent inconsistency. The US$3.5 billion prior-year revenue figure and the US$2.3 billion annualised revenue figure cannot both be read as the same measure without clarification. I would not rely on either as a precise current revenue figure without checking Canva's own disclosures.

Perkins described the change as "without doubt the hardest moment in our thirteen-year history" ([Poduval, 2026, November 4](https://uxuiopen.com/blog/canva-layoff)). She also said that small adjustments would not be enough to address the slowdown ([Bashir, 2026, November 4](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/canva-first-growth-slowdown-decade-092457264.html)).

## 3. Analysis and Assessment

**Our view: the restructuring is a bet that execution speed, not market access, is now the binding constraint.** The clearest signal is the merger of Product, Growth and Platform. A LinkedIn commentary by a growth leader argues that the handoff between product and growth is where speed is lost, and that specialists who cannot ship end to end are most at risk ([LinkedIn, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140)). That argument is an opinion, but it is consistent with Canva's stated rationale.

Three points follow from the evidence:

1. **The headline number is not the job-loss number.** Because the 1,271 figure includes relocations and role changes, the actual number of departures will be lower and is not yet known ([Greenwood, n.d.](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250)). Any briefing should avoid treating 1,271 as a count of redundancies.

2. **The enterprise pivot and the reorganisation are linked.** The launches in the MarTech Cube coverage (Canva Enterprise, workflow and data integrations, Affinity for professionals) require cross-functional execution across product, growth and platform ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products); [Kirkpatrick, 2026, May 28](https://futurumgroup.com/insights/canvas-may-2026-launches-signal-an-enterprise-platform-ambition-beyond-design)). The merger is therefore plausibly a precondition for that roadmap rather than a separate cost measure.

3. **Sydney centralisation carries relocation and retention risk.** Relocation is part of the reported 1,271 figure, and the choice to move product teams to Sydney may affect the people willing to stay ([Greenwood, n.d.](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250)). Retention of key product and platform talent is a legitimate concern for the next quarter.

The unresolved issue is whether the reorganisation improves speed or simply removes capacity. The materials do not contain metrics on cycle time, release frequency or the cost of handovers. Without those, the claim that the merger will speed up delivery is unproven.

## 4. Verification and Source Reliability

| Item | Status | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Restructuring, 1,271 roles, 22% | Verified across multiple outlets | Canva newsroom reference; Newsweek; Yahoo/BeInCrypto; Niehues |
| Announcement date | Inconsistent: 3 November (Newsweek, Niehues, People Matters) vs. 4 November (CTO Magazine, Yahoo) | Flagged; the 3 November date is used here |
| All Hands dates (10 and 11 November) | Verified from primary source | [Canva, 2026, November 3](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-team-update) |
| Further cuts or hiring freeze | Unverified; secondhand report | [Srivastava, 2026, November 3](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137) |
| Enterprise launches | Content verified; date not visible | [MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products) |
| Ortto/Simtheory acquisition | Content verified; date not visible; user count conflicts with other source | [Demand Gen Report, n.d.](https://www.demandgenreport.com/industry-news/news-brief/canva-acquisitions-expands-marketing-ai-capabilities/52546) |
| Growth forecast cut (August 2026) | Outside window; cited second-hand from Fortune | [Niehues, 2026, November 9](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Enterprise strategy analysis (May 2026) | Outside window; background only | [Kirkpatrick, 2026, May 28](https://futurumgroup.com/insights/canvas-may-2026-launches-signal-an-enterprise-platform-ambition-beyond-design) |
| Leadership hires | None found in window | Not verified; check newsroom |
| Post-10 November developments | Not covered in the materials | Gap; must be checked before the meeting |

**Source reliability note.** The Canva newsroom memo is the primary source and should be weighted most heavily. Newsweek and Yahoo/BeInCrypto are general news outlets. Niehues, CTO Magazine, LinkedIn and UX/UI Open are commentary or consultancy content and contain interpretation. Niehues also has a commercial interest in consulting services. Commentary is cited here only for context, not for facts about Canva's decisions. The Capital Brief report is secondhand.

**Exit-package comparison caveat.** Niehues compares Canva's six-month severance with German statutory notice and severance rules. That comparison is specific to German employees and should not be generalised to Canva's Australian or global workforce.

## 5. Recommended Preparation for 17 November

- Confirm the status of the 10 and 11 November All Hands and what was said about the new organisation chart.
- Check Canva's newsroom for any leadership appointments and for the dates of the enterprise launches.
- Verify whether the Capital Brief report on further cuts or a hiring freeze has been confirmed or denied.
- Clarify the revenue figures (US$2.3 billion annualised versus US$3.5 billion prior year).

## 6. Three Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **What is the expected net departure figure?** Of the 1,271 affected staff, how many are role eliminations, how many are role changes, and how many are relocations? When will relocation decisions be final, and what is the expected number of departures?

2. **How will the merged product organisation measure success?** What decision rights, cycle-time or release-frequency metrics will the new Product organisation use to show that removing handovers has improved delivery speed, and how will this support the enterprise roadmap (Canva Enterprise, workflow automation, Affinity for professionals)?

3. **Is a hiring freeze under consideration, and how will critical capabilities be retained?** Does Canva plan a company-wide hiring freeze or further redundancies in November, as reported by Capital Brief, and what is the plan to retain the product, platform and specialist talent needed for the enterprise pivot, given the Sydney centralisation?

Chris G | VC + Startups on Instagram: "Canva’s 2026 layoffs have a plot twist: the company is helping its former employees become entrepreneurs.

Imagine getting laid off and your employer offers to help fund your next startup. That’s essentially what Canva is doing.

CEO Melanie Perkins announced a restructuring affecting 1,271 employees, or 22% of the workforce. Not all are being laid off; some face role changes or relocation.

But look at the exit package:

→ At least 6 months of salary
→ 12 months of healthcare where available
→ Employees keep their MacBooks
→ $10,000 startup grants through the Canva Collective Fund, with no equity taken
→ Career coaching and LinkedIn Premium

Now here’s what investors should actually pay attention to.

Canva lowered its 2026 revenue growth forecast from 30% to 20% as AI costs put pressure on its business model.

Meanwhile, Product, Growth, and Platform are being consolidated into one organization.

Translation: AI isn’t just changing what software companies sell. It’s changing the cost of delivering their products and how teams need to operate.

And here’s the overlooked opportunity: Canva’s departing talent could become the next generation of startup founders.

Losing your job is never easy. But giving employees financial runway, healthcare, and a chance to build something new is a much better exit than simply handing them a severance check.

The lesson for founders? How you treat employees on the way out says a lot about how you build a company.

Would you rather have six months of severance or a shot at funding your own startup?
